subtopic: Investment Advisory Agreements and Terms of Service
source_evidence:
Your investment advisory agreement will give you specific information about the fees you will pay and the services you will receive.
Information or terms in those agreements might be incorporated in your advisory agreement (or vice versa).
question: Why should you read an investment advisory agreement and any related Terms of Service before accepting an adviser’s offer?
answer: The advisory agreement explains the fees you will pay and the services you will receive. Terms of Service or similar agreements may also contain terms that are incorporated into the advisory agreement, so review both before accepting.
